entries.title: Psalms 146:2
segments: As long as I live will I praise Jehovah; I will sing psalms unto my God while I have my being.

entries.title: Psalms 146:3
segments: Put not confidence in nobles, in a son of man, in whom there is no salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 146:4
segments: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his purposes perish.

entries.title: Psalms 146:5
segments: ¶Blessed is he who hath the *God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Jehovah his God,

entries.title: Psalms 146:6
segments: Who made the heavens and the earth, the sea and all that is therein; who keepeth truth for ever;

entries.title: Psalms 146:7
segments: Who executeth judgment for the oppressed, who giveth bread to the hungry. Jehovah looseth the prisoners;

entries.title: Psalms 146:8
segments: Jehovah openeth [the eyes of] the blind; Jehovah raiseth up them that are bowed down; Jehovah loveth the righteous;

entries.title: Psalms 146:9
segments: Jehovah preserveth the strangers; he lifteth up the fatherless and the widow; but the way of the wicked doth he subvert.

entries.title: Psalms 146:10
segments: Jehovah will reign for ever, [even] thy God, O Zion, from generation to generation. Hallelujah!
